SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are some stories more outstanding than others? 2. How can we improve our writing skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication is enhanced as the learner writes a narrative composition effectively using the specified idioms.

● Collaboration is enhanced as the learner reflects on progress made as they share their compositions.

● Digital Literacy is achieved as learners interact with technology when confirming online the meaning of the specified idioms.

Values:
Respect is fostered as the learner listens to peers' opinions and views about their compositions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Effective Communication is achieved as the learner expresses their ideas creatively in narrative composition.
